messages:
zoe: Quick sync — we need a concrete rollout plan for tenant-affinity changes + graceful eviction. Customer asks: no user-facing errors during model fallback, prefer latency vs cost tradeoff opts.
aj: +1. My concerns: affinity change will reshuffle KV caches and cause transient latency spikes for hot tenants. Need canary cadence.
carmen: We should protect top 20 tenants with holdout flag during the first 48h. For others we can do rolling waves. Also propose circuit-breaker at 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m.
nate: Metric asks from sales: per-tenant p50/p95 latency, error rate, and token cost delta. We need these in the dashboard by first canary.
emily: UX note — show a quiet banner for affected customers? Or only notify if degradation > 1% SLA. Less noisy is better.
zoe: Plan draft: 1) small canary (1% traffic) for 2h with affinity disabled for non-top tenants, 2) expand 10% for 6h, 3) 50% for 12h, 4) full. Each step gated by metrics and manual approval.
aj: Suggest adding A/B test window: keep a shadow path that logs outputs for quality comparison for full 24h before widening. That avoids regressions.
carmen: Agree. Also implement fast rollback path: flag flip + immediate routing fallback to previous affinity map. Rollback time target < 60s.
zoe: Add escape hatch: per-tenant force-pin flag (for sales/ops) and global kill-switch. Document APIs for both.
aj: Example flag snippet we can use in rollout playbook:```json
{"flag_name":"affinity_v2","rollout": "percent","value":20,"exceptions": ["tenant:acct-1234","tenant:acct-9876"]}```
carmen: Ops config: circuit-breaker thresholds:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR
- p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 10m
Triggers: auto-shrink to previous model variant and notify #eng-oncall + #product.
zoe: Launch criteria: all checks green through 50% for 12h, no customer >1% error lift, and sales top-20 acceptance.
nate: One negotiation: sales wants top-5 whitelisted for 2 weeks. Product wants 48h. Compromise: top-5 exempt for 7 days, top-6-20 exempt for 48h.
emily: We'll prepare a customer-facing status template for the 7-day window.
aj: Need telemetry hooks: tag requests with rollout-cohort + affinity-state, so we can slice. Also export to BigQuery nightly for cost analysis.
carmen: I'll add a short-term alert in PagerDuty for p50/p95 spikes during canaries. Ops playbook will include steps: 1) flip flag, 2) clear local caches, 3) verify KV evictions not spiking, 4) escalate.
zoe: Who owns runbook? aj (eng) for implementation, carmen for alerts, emily for comms, nate for sales approvals.
aj: ETA for first canary (1%) — aiming tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need a small migration window script to pre-populate affinity hints.
nate: Confirmed I’ll get approvals for top-5 holdout.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered by aj — stage: canary-1% — started at 1719502600.
carmen: Quick checklist before deploy: migration script in QA, dashboard queries ready, PD escalation policy set.
zoe: OK set. If anything looks off in first 30m we abort and flip global flag. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
